biggest_catch: You only get paid if your friend becomes a DFCU member, opens a new checking account, and within 90 days makes two direct deposits of $100+ AND five Mastercard debit card transactions (PIN/signature, ATM excluded). A friend who joins but never uses the account earns you nothing.
catches: Checking tier: new member must make two (2) direct deposits of $100 or more AND five (5) Mastercard debit card transactions (PIN/signature, ATM excluded) within 90 days.
Not available to referred persons who are already DFCU members.
Reward Card arrives 4-6 weeks after qualifications are completed.
DFCU may amend, suspend, or terminate the referral program at any time without notice.
Tax treatment not stated; treat as potentially reportable income.

steps: Register for the DFCU ReferLive Checking Account Referral Program.
Share the referral offer with friends and family.
Friend becomes a DFCU member, completes ReferLive registration, and opens a new checking account.
Friend completes the qualification requirements: 2x $100+ direct deposits + 5 Mastercard debit transactions within 90 days.
You receive a $100 Reward card per qualifying referral.
timing: Reward Card arrives 4-6 weeks after the referred person completes all qualification requirements.
